title: Stiching/Thread  shadow
content:
![d91b01b2f2554e55b2f5e9d625a56991](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202507/cf77b67b38eb43fb8d85d721fd773781/images/d91b01b2f2554e55b2f5e9d625a56991image.png)Hello Everyone,

Please suggest

3d Rendered image showing shadow effect.

original image below is desired requirement. Please suggest how can we achieve?

![d7e24801570a48a49ed21d669e3e8e05](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202507/cf77b67b38eb43fb8d85d721fd773781/images/d7e24801570a48a49ed21d669e3e8e05IMG20250731120428.jpg)

Regards,

nk

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi,I tried and successful with edited thread texture shadow in PS. IT WORKS.👍🏻Thanks!

Comment 2: Hi. It possibly may also help if you remove the Normal Map from the Sewing where the seam is sewn together

Comment 3: hI lUCILE,Thanks for connectingIt is already off, this option of 3d , uncheck or not is doing nothing for me (myside).
Reply 1: Hi! On your screenshot, is it 2 patterns sewn together and then a topstitch on the seamline or is it just a topstitch on an internal line?If it's the first option, then you can use the Edit Sewing tool, select the sewing line and delete the normal map in the Property Editor.

Comment 4: Hi, please untick the '3D' option in the Property Editor of your top stitch and it should remove the shadow.
content_description: A community forum page for users to share and discuss techniques on creating 3D rendered images with shadow effects.

title: Not repeat lines (uneven design)
content:
![fe719ec31ce143cc8115521121aca124](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202507/24f6c87280684481917a3f2307c03235/images/fe719ec31ce143cc8115521121aca124RUNNER-TARGET-H%26H.jpg)Hi ,

I need 2 different lines as shown in image. both the lines are of different design with pattern design in back. Created horizontal lines in transformation but manageable (although i did not fully satisfy with extended design) when i am using line it creates repeat pattern in vertical line.

using only 2048 x 2048 and 4096 x4096 pattern design

Please help on this.

Regards,

NK

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Neeraj, sorry for seeing only now! (For refererence, I do not receive a notification if the reply is not directly underneath my own comment.) You can add the image as a graphic and then have it repeat only along the X- or Y-axis. Unified is for UV maps so it will not give the desired effect.

Comment 2: Hi,I edited it in PS but CLO creates pattern and i do not want to transform it manually.Please just look at my given image it is 14x72 inches, How can i use pattern. I bounded with pattern 2048x2048, 4096x4096, 8192x8192. 🙏🏻 Thanks,NK

Comment 3: Hi,not fully working that. My size is 14 x 72 inches and i bounded with pattern 2048x2048, 4096x4096, 8192x8192. CLO making a pattern only not single stripe. I used unified also.Thanks,Nk

Comment 4: yes it is from PS. My concern is that i did not want repeat to display horizontal stripe and vertical stripe. So that my 14 x72 in covers only once in horizontal stripe and vertical stripe. I also used unified option in texture mapping but it also given repeat.

Comment 5: Hi, from what I am understanding about this, shouldn't the image rather be edited in e.g. PS?
content_description: Purpose: To showcase and seek advice on creating two distinct horizontal line designs with patterned backgrounds for seamless use in 2048x2048 and 4096x4096 textures.
